subject: Blue Harbor — RCA, timeline, and verification plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft RCA and verification plan for Blue Harbor - approval to send

Hi team,

Attached is the draft RCA and the verification checklist for Blue Harbor (incident on 2026-08-10). I pulled together the timeline and the proposed corrective actions. Key points: 
- Root cause: degraded KV cache eviction algorithm interacting with quantized model variant under sustained burst traffic.
- Customer impact: elevated token latency and occasional 503s for ~18 mins during the burst window.
- Immediate remediation: reverted to stable quantization profile and increased KV cache reservation for the account.

What I need from you before we send to Blue Harbor: 
1) Sign-off on phrasing around root cause and the mitigations (I tried to avoid overly technical terms).
2) Confirmation of the verification plan dates (I proposed Aug 19–20 for a short verification window).
3) Final attachments — timeline export and SLA impact CSV are attached as stubs.

Attachments: postmortem_RCA_draft.pdf, timeline_export.tsv (draft)

If I don't hear objections by EOD today I will send the customer-facing RCA tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft RCA and verification plan for Blue Harbor - approval to send

Thanks Connor — looks solid. A couple of suggested edits (see inline):
- Reword root cause sentence to: "A mismatch between the KV cache eviction policy and the memory characteristics of the quantized model variant caused premature cache churn under sustained burst traffic, increasing cold cache fetches and token latency."
- Add a one-line mitigation timeline showing when we rolled the config back (timestamped).
- For the verification window, propose Aug 19 10–11am PT or Aug 20 2–3pm PT; include both and ask customer to confirm.

I approve sending once those edits are applied. Let's not promise SLA credits in the RCA; handle credits in a follow-up note with Finance.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Meyer <alice@blueharbor.com>, Tom Liao <tom.liao@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Blue Harbor — RCA, timeline, and verification plan

Alice / Tom,

Thank you again for working with us while we investigated the disruption on 2026-08-10. Attached is our customer-facing RCA and the verification plan we propose. This thread is intended to summarize what happened, what we changed, and next steps for verification and follow-up.

Summary (short):
- What happened: Under a sustained traffic burst we observed a sharp increase in KV cache evictions for the quantized model variant assigned to Blue Harbor, which increased cold-cache lookups and per-token latency. A small fraction of requests experienced 5xx responses during the peak.
- Impact window: 11:02–11:20 PT on 2026-08-10. Peak elevated token latency (95th percentile) increased by ~420ms. Estimated affected requests: ~0.8% of Blue Harbor traffic for that window.
- Immediate mitigations: rolled back to the previous quantization profile at 11:21 PT, increased KV cache reservation for the account, and added a temporary throttle for burst smoothing.

Timeline (high level):
- 11:02 PT — traffic spike detected by monitoring; automatic alert routed to on-call.
- 11:06 PT — spike correlated to burst pattern from a partner job; root cause investigation started.
- 11:10 PT — first signs of increased eviction pressure on KV cache.
- 11:21 PT — rollback applied; token latency returned to baseline by 11:26 PT.

Action items we will complete (owners / ETA):
- Persist KV cache reservation change for Blue Harbor (Infra — Sergio) — completed 2026-08-10 11:30 PT.
- Update quantization selection policy to incorporate eviction metrics (Runtime — Marissa) — ETA 2026-09-03.
- Add automated regression test for quantized variants under burst patterns (Platform QA — Grace) — ETA 2026-09-10.
- Provide a verification window: Aug 19 or Aug 20 — we request a 30-minute check to validate stable behavior and share logs.

Attachments included: postmortem_RCA_v1.pdf (formal RCA), timeline_export.tsv, sla_report.csv

Requested customer actions: please confirm preferred verification slot (Aug 19 10–10:30am PT or Aug 20 2–2:30pm PT) and confirm whether you want us to present the technical walk-through or just run the verification checks.

We are available to discuss and can also provide a redacted logs packet if it's helpful for your compliance team.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0198
From: Alice Meyer <alice@blueharbor.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liao <tom.liao@blueharbor.com>, support@blueharbor.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Blue Harbor — RCA, timeline, and verification plan

Connor — thank you for the clear write-up and the attachments. A couple of quick requests before we confirm the verification slot: 
1) Can you provide the redacted log packet you mentioned with just Blue Harbor's request IDs (no internal hostnames)? Our compliance team needs that for audit.
2) On the SLA impact CSV: can you confirm how you calculated the affected request percentage? The numbers in our internal dashboard look slightly different; we'd like to reconcile.

Also, we'll likely need a DocuSign for any credits you propose; could you send the correct DocuSign link or a statement of credits for our procurement team to review?

Preferred verification slot for now: Aug 19 10–10:30am PT. If we need a technical walk-through we'll let you know.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Meyer
Head of Platform Reliability
Blue Harbor Fintech

Subject: Re: Blue Harbor — RCA, timeline, and verification plan

Alice — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming Aug 19 10–10:30am PT. Answers inline: 

1) Redacted logs: Attached is a packet scoped to Blue Harbor request IDs with internal fields redacted. Filename: credits_doc_20260817.pdf (contains the redacted logs link and the proposed credits statement). If you want them in a different format (ndjson) we can provide that.

2) SLA impact calculation: we calculated affected requests from sampled telemetry across the account and then extrapolated to the full window. The CSV includes the sample size and confidence bounds; if you send us your dashboard export (even a screenshot) we'll reconcile the two numbers together on the verification call.

DocuSign / credits: we've prepared a draft credits statement (included in the attachment) and can open a DocuSign if procurement prefers. I'll coordinate with Finance to generate the DocuSign link and post it to this thread by EOD today.

Verification call: I'll schedule the 30-minute slot and share the calendar invite now: https://calendly.com/redwood/blueharbor-verification-30m. Tech leads from our runtime and infra teams (Marissa + Sergio) will be on the call.

Let me know if there are any other items you need before the 19th.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credits_doc_20260817.pdf (redacted logs link + credits statement)
